title: SEC6: CID re-derivation guards against peer substitution
description: In xcid_client.rs run_xcid_protocol, after deserializing the LogEntry from DAG-CBOR bytes received from a peer, the code recomputes LogEntryId::from_entry(&entry) and compares it to the requested ID before accepting the entry. This guards against a malicious or buggy peer that serves a different entry under the same CID string. Content-addressing in the CID only covers the bytes-on-the-wire; after deserialization, round-trip drift or deliberate substitution could produce an entry whose fields differ from the requested one without triggering a CID check. The re-derivation closes this gap. Decision: always recompute and reject on mismatch, do not trust the peer to serve the correct entry.
